slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Not covered here? Ask us directly — same working day response.

slots.label: Question 1
slots.default: Do you have an office in South Wales?

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: No. Our offices are at 124 City Rd in London and Caxton Point in Stevenage, and we would rather say so than list a virtual address in South Wales. The region is covered by our UK service desk plus field engineers who travel to customer sites across Cardiff, Swansea, Newport and beyond. Most issues never need a visit: we respond the same working day and resolve most issues remotely. When a visit is requested we aim to have an engineer with you the same working day.

slots.label: Question 2
slots.default: What IT services does my business need?

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: It depends on your size, sector and goals, but most businesses need reliable support, secure cloud services, cyber security and dependable networks. We start by understanding how you work, then recommend only what genuinely helps, nothing you don’t need.

slots.label: Question 3
slots.default: Why choose WhizzIT over other providers?

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: We’re a small, family-run managed service provider that prioritises exceptional service. We work proactively to prevent problems rather than simply reacting to them, and we explain everything in plain English so you always feel in control of your IT.

slots.label: Paragraph 5
slots.default: Yes. We offer flexible, cost-effective solutions that give you serious technology and protection at a price that fits your budget and grows with you.

slots.label: Paragraph 6
slots.default: We do. As well as South Wales towns like Cardiff, Swansea and Newport, we support businesses in North Wales including Wrexham and Bangor, and further afield. Most issues are handled remotely, with onsite engineers arranged where distance calls for it.

slots.label: Paragraph 7
slots.default: Outsourced IT support means handing the day-to-day running, maintenance and security of your technology to a specialist partner. Instead of hiring and managing an in-house team, you get a whole service desk, proactive monitoring and expert engineers for a predictable monthly cost.

slots.label: Paragraph 8
slots.default: Simply get in touch for a free consultation. We’ll assess your current setup and business needs, then recommend the right support package. Onboarding is straightforward: we review your systems, set up any tooling for remote assistance, and start supporting your team.
